title: Timeframes and chart types
goal: Learn to switch the timeframe of a chart.

objectives.text: Know the candle chart and the line chart.
Switch a chart to a new timeframe.

slides.text: A timeframe is how long one candle lasts. On a 5m chart, a candle lasts 5 min.
slides.title: What is a timeframe?

slides.text: Tap 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, D or W to switch. The m is for minute, h is for hour. D is day and W is week.
slides.title: The buttons

slides.text: Minute and hour charts are intraday charts. Intraday means inside one day.
slides.title: Inside one day

slides.text: A small timeframe shows more wiggles. Each candle here lasts 5 min.
slides.title: A small timeframe

demo.caption: These prices are made up for practice.

slides.text: A big timeframe shows the big picture. Each candle here lasts one day.
slides.title: A big timeframe

demo.caption: These are real Apple prices from 2015 and 2016.

slides.text: A candle chart shows four prices for each time. A line chart joins only the close prices. Bar and area charts are more looks.
slides.title: Chart types

questions.prompt: What does one candle on a 5m chart show?
questions.explanation: On a 5m chart, each candle lasts 5 min.

questions.prompt: A timeframe is how long one candle lasts.
questions.explanation: Yes. On a 1h chart, each candle lasts one hour.

questions.prompt: Match each button to its time.
questions.explanation: m is minute, h is hour, D is day, W is week.

questions.prompt: Which one is an intraday chart?
questions.explanation: Intraday means inside one day. Min and hour charts are intraday.

questions.prompt: A line chart joins the close prices.
questions.explanation: Yes. It uses just the close.

questions.prompt: Which chart hides the high and low?
questions.explanation: The line chart shows just the close. The high and low are hidden.
One candle lasts an hour here. You see fewer candles.
The 5m chart has more candles. It wiggles more.
